fact: The Digital Eswatini project document of 8 June 2026 allocates US$8 million of an IBRD loan to National Broadband Network Expansion, building or upgrading 24 non-commercial backbone segments (Joint EPTC-EEC Broadband Expansion plan); the text ties it to the project, not to an adopted national broadband plan.
title: Project Appraisal Document: Digital Eswatini
